title: Author filter is exact, case-sensitive equality
evidence: app.py:83 `SELECT * FROM books WHERE author = ?` — no LIKE/normalization
suggestion: Acceptable per spec; consider case-insensitive/substring match if fuzzy filtering is desired

title: GET /books has no pagination
evidence: app.py:78-86 returns the full collection unconditionally
suggestion: Not required by spec; add ?limit/?offset if large collections are expected

title: No uniqueness constraint on isbn
evidence: app.py:8-16 schema allows duplicate isbn values
suggestion: Not required by spec; add a UNIQUE index if isbn should be unique
